services.desc: No BoundariesAt the Virginia Quilt MuseumFiber ExhibitionJuried by Patty Kennedy-Zafred‍March 31 - June 27, 2026 Artists are invited to interpret the theme, "No Boundaries" in an original piece of fiber-based artwork. Boundaries can keep things in or keep things out. They may be physical, geographical, or even emotional. The pieces will be jurored by Patty Kennedy-Zafred, who tells stories through the medium of textiles and art quilts for over thirty years, creating thought provoking narratives using fabric, dyes, silkscreens, and ink to develop a visual dialogue with the viewer. The top 41 pieces of over 200 will be on display in this exhibit. We hope you enjoy this collection of fiber-art

blurb: The Virginia Quilt Museum exists to celebrate and nurture Virginia’s quilting heritage by collecting and preserving quilts from Virginia for the benefit of the public for educational purposes, to be accessible to them through regular exhibition and maintained for future generations.
